example_prompt: Handle SasPay webhooks to confirm an order once its transaction.success event arrives, after checking the signature.

input_schema.description: Body SasPay POSTs to your webhook URL, with headers X-Webhook-Signature (lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256), X-Webhook-Timestamp (Unix seconds) and X-Webhook-Event (the event type).

data.description: Shape for transaction.* events, as documented for transaction.success.

id.description: Transaction id. Use it to make processing idempotent.

fee.description: Fee charged to the customer, decimal string.

charged.description: What the payer actually paid, decimal string.

msisdn.description: Number debited (payin) or credited (payout). Empty before 17 August 2026.

response_schema.description: Return HTTP 2xx within 15 seconds. The body is ignored.

gotchas: Verify X-Webhook-Signature before anything else: it is the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with your webhook's signing_secret (SASPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET), of the X-Webhook-Timestamp value, a dot, then the raw body: `${timestamp}.${rawBody}`.

Reject the request when X-Webhook-Timestamp (Unix seconds) is more than 5 minutes from your clock: without this check an intercepted webhook stays replayable forever, since its signature never expires.

Compute the signature over the raw request body, never over a re-serialised parsed payload (key order or number formatting can differ). Express: mount express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }) on this route.
Compare signatures in constant time (crypto.timingSafeEqual, hmac.compare_digest, hash_equals), never with ===.

signing_secret is shown only once, in the creation or rotation response, and never returned by the read endpoints: copy it then. If lost, set a new one from the dashboard (Webhooks → Changer le secret).
Webhooks and subscriptions can only be created, changed or deleted from the dashboard; the API key can only list and read them.

Each event is attempted 5 times (immediately, then +30s, +5min, +30min, +2h) with a 15s timeout per attempt, then marked FAILED for good (only a manual resend from the dashboard retries it). Answer 2xx right away, process in the background, and make processing idempotent on data.id, since a retried event can arrive twice.
For accounting use data.charged (what left the payer) and data.net_amount (what you receive), never data.amount alone: which one includes the fee depends on fee_charge_mode.
Do not depend on the exact data shape of settlement.* events: SasPay states it is not guaranteed yet.
data.msisdn is empty on transactions created before 17 August 2026; country, network and the amounts are always present.

spans: La signature couvre l'horodatage **et** le corps, séparés par un point :
rejetez si `X-Webhook-Timestamp` s'écarte de plus de **5 minutes** de votre horloge.
recalculez-la sur le **corps brut reçu**, jamais sur une re-sérialisation de `payload`
Il n'apparaît qu'**une seule fois**, dans la réponse de création et dans celle d'une rotation de secret
se fait **exclusivement depuis le [tableau de bord](https://app.saspay.me)**
utilisez `charged` (ce qui a quitté le compte du client) et `net_amount` (ce qui vous revient) — jamais `amount` seul.
le contenu de `data` n'est pas garanti pour ces events précis pour le moment
`msisdn` est vide sur les transactions antérieures au 17 août 2026
